Preflight: ok
cloudflare: 6 step(s)
  PUT /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/workers/subdomain {"subdomain":"nitish-pv"} (asks first)
  npx wrangler r2 bucket create pv-derived
  npx wrangler r2 bucket create pv-lake
  npx wrangler kv namespace create pv-cache (records id)
  npx wrangler queues create pv-retention-dlq
  npx wrangler basin catalog enable pv-lake (records PV_CATALOG_URI and PV_CATALOG_WAREHOUSE in .secrets/prod.env)
gcp: 1 step(s)
  uv run --project pipelines pv setup gcp (idempotent; its own plan: uv run --project pipelines pv setup gcp --dry-run)
worker: 5 step(s)
  record PV_BASE_URL=https://peoplevault.nitish-pv.workers.dev in .secrets/prod.env
  generate PV_PSEUDONYM_MASTER_KEY (32 random bytes) into .secrets/worker-secrets.env, once; copy it to your password manager
  render infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc from the template (D1 id, KV id, ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN, ACCESS_AUD = pending-access-application until the Access application exists, GCP_PROJECT_ID, RETENTION_CRON=off)
  npx wrangler d1 migrations apply pv-control --remote -c infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc
  npm run deploy (npx wrangler deploy -c infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc --secrets-file .secrets/worker-secrets.env)
access: 7 step(s)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/service_tokens/st-1/rotate (secret not recorded; new secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_EXECUTOR)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-hr","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_HR / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_HR)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-manager","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_MANAGER / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_MANAGER)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-analyst","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_ANALYST / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_ANALYST)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/service_tokens {"name":"pv-persona-privacy","duration":"8760h"} (client id and secret into .secrets/prod.env as PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID_PRIVACY / PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET_PRIVACY)
  POST /client/v4/accounts/acct-0123/access/apps (infra/cloudflare/access-app.template.json: worker destination for peoplevault, allow-owner for 4 email(s), service-tokens for 5 tokens)
  render ACCESS_AUD from the Access application into infra/cloudflare/wrangler.production.jsonc, then npm run deploy
data: 3 step(s)
  npm run seed:prod (remote D1 seed and principal mapping, 41 export objects, lake self-test and table, snapshot expiration, pv load --target prod, counts and controls)
  uv run --project pipelines pv audit export --target prod (creates the Basin Catalog table governance.audit_events and copies the audit chain)
  npx wrangler basin catalog snapshot-expiration enable pv-lake governance audit_events
github: 5 step(s) (asks first)
  uv run --project pipelines pv setup actions-key --repo nitishsjsucs/peoplevault (creates a peoplevault-executor key and pipes it into gh secret set PV_GCP_EXECUTOR_KEY; never written to disk)
  gh secret set PV_GCP_PROJECT --app actions --repo nitishsjsucs/peoplevault (value on stdin)
  gh secret set PV_R2_CATALOG_TOKEN --app actions --repo nitishsjsucs/peoplevault (value on stdin)
  waiting for PV_BASE_URL, PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID, PV_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET, PV_CATALOG_URI, PV_CATALOG_WAREHOUSE, PV_POLICY_TAGS_JSON: run the cloudflare, gcp, worker and access groups first
  gh variable set PV_PROD_ENABLED --body true --repo nitishsjsucs/peoplevault (executor.yml runs hourly from then on)
